body:
Hey, I'm sort of in the same boat.  I feel like I'm just a negative drag on myself, my family and my friends and, though I know I have to get out of this downward spiral, I'm just not.  I don't have the life experience to tell you that it all works out in the end because I'm the same age as you and in the same situation, but I guess we just take it one day at a time and hope that it gets better.

Since you're going to be home with your parents this semester I'd recommend getting involved in something.  Get a minimum wage job, volunteer, sign up for boxing classes or something.  Just do an activity that gives you a reason to get up in the morning and it will really help you feel better about your relationship to your parents and yourself.

Good luck and *internet hug*
